name: Working Matter
thesis: A fold-out engineering publication turns Raygen’s machines into full-size visual arguments for making things.
interaction: A yellow construction tab replaces DAVID’s rendered assembly with a clearly labeled, precise conceptual linkage diagram; the publication continues through SERV0 and Hack Club.
why: DAVID leads as a physical artifact, framed by condensed technical-publication typography, a yellow vertical spine, deliberate fold lines, and personal workshop language.
